about: Easyday's exercise library. Edit here, then run `python mobile/tool/gen_library.py` to regenerate mobile/lib/data/exercises.g.dart. The rules for every field are in docs/app/EXERCISE_DATA.md.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below where the bar touches your chest. Lie on the bench, feet flat, bar over your chest. Lower it to your mid-chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your body, then press it back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: Lie on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest height. Press both up until your arms are straight, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.how: Set the bench to a low incline. Press the dumbbells up from shoulder height until your arms are straight, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.how: Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells at chest height with upper arms resting on the floor. Press up, then lower until your arms touch down again.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.how: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest. Press forward until your arms are nearly straight, then bring the handles back without letting the weight stack touch.

exercises.name: Smith machine bench press
exercises.how: Set a flat bench so the Smith bar lowers to your mid-chest, and set the safety stops. Unhook the bar, lower with your wrists over your elbows, then press back up with your shoulders on the bench.

exercises.name: Dips

ladder.name: Assisted dips
ladder.note: band under the knees or the assist machine
ladder.how: Loop a band over the bars and kneel on it, or use the assist machine. Lower until your upper arms are parallel with the floor, then press up.

ladder.name: Negative dips
ladder.note: jump up, lower over 3 seconds
ladder.how: Jump or step to the top position with straight arms. Lower yourself as slowly as you can, about 3 seconds, then step down and reset.

ladder.name: Dips
ladder.how: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms. Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel with the floor, then push back up.

ladder.name: Paused dips
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms and lean slightly forward. Lower until your upper arms are about parallel with the floor, pause there for 2 seconds, then press back up.

ladder.name: Slow dips
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms and lean slightly forward. Take 3 seconds to lower until your upper arms are about parallel with the floor, then press back up.

exercises.how: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms. Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel with the floor, then push back up.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.how: Stand between the cables with a handle in each hand, slight bend in the elbows. Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arc, then open slowly. You can also lie on a flat bench between low pulleys and sweep your hands together above your chest.

exercises.name: Push-ups

ladder.name: Wall push-ups
ladder.how: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it at shoulder height. Bend your elbows to bring your chest to the wall, then push away.

ladder.name: Incline push-ups
ladder.note: hands on a bench or counter
ladder.how: Hands on a bench, counter or step, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the edge with elbows about 45 degrees out, then push back up.

ladder.name: Knee push-ups
ladder.how: Knees on the floor, hands under your shoulders, hips in line with your shoulders and knees. Lower your chest to just above the floor, then push back up.

ladder.name: Push-ups
ladder.how: Hands under your shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor with elbows tucked about 45 degrees, then push back up.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated push-ups
ladder.how: Feet up on a bench or step, hands under your shoulders. Keep the hips in line and lower your chest to the floor, then press up.

ladder.name: Archer push-ups
ladder.note: one arm does most of the work
ladder.how: Hands wide. Shift toward one hand as you lower so that arm bends and the other stays nearly straight, then press up. Alternate sides.

ladder.name: One-arm push-ups
ladder.note: Use a wide foot stance and lower under control with one hand beneath the shoulder, keeping your hips from twisting. Practise progressively lower one-arm incline reps first.

exercises.how: Hands under your shoulders, body in a straight line. Lower your chest to just above the floor with elbows tucked about 45 degrees, then push back up.

exercises.name: Incline barbell bench press
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below where the bar touches your chest. Bench at a low incline, bar over your upper chest. Lower it to just below the collarbones, then press back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.how: Lie on the bench with dumbbells above your chest and a small bend in your elbows. Keep that bend as you open your arms to a comfortable stretch, then bring the dumbbells together without pressing.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.how: Lie along a flat bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands and a small elbow bend. Keep that bend fixed as you lower behind your head through a comfortable range, then return without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Pec deck
exercises.how: Elbows or forearms on the pads at chest height. Squeeze the pads together in front of you, pause, and open slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell floor press
exercises.how: Lie on the floor, bell resting on the back of your forearm. Press up until your arm is straight, then lower until your upper arm touches the floor.

exercises.name: Suspension push-ups

ladder.name: Upright suspension push-ups
ladder.note: body nearly vertical
ladder.how: Straps short, lean into the handles with your body nearly upright. Lower your chest between the handles, then press away.

ladder.name: Suspension push-ups
ladder.note: body at 45 degrees
ladder.how: Body at about 45 degrees, handles at chest height. Lower your chest between the handles, then press back up.

ladder.name: Low suspension push-ups
ladder.note: body nearly flat
ladder.how: Straps long, body nearly flat. Lower your chest between the handles without letting the straps wobble, then press up.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated suspension push-ups
ladder.how: Feet on a box, body flat. Lower your chest between the handles and press up.

ladder.name: Suspension archer push-ups
ladder.how: Shift toward one handle as you lower so that arm bends and the other stays nearly straight, then press up. Alternate.

exercises.how: Handles low, body in a straight line. Lower your chest between the handles, then press back up without letting the straps wobble.

exercises.name: Band chest press

ladder.name: Light band chest press
ladder.how: Band anchored behind you at chest height, handles at your chest. Press forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band chest press
ladder.how: Band anchored behind you at chest height, handles at your chest. Press forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band chest press
ladder.how: Band anchored behind you at chest height, handles at your chest. Press forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band chest press
ladder.how: Band anchored behind you at chest height, handles at your chest. Press forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Band anchored behind you at chest height, handles at your chest. Press forward until your arms are straight, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Band chest fly

ladder.name: Light band fly
ladder.note: Use a light band with tension through a comfortable full arc.

ladder.name: Medium band fly
ladder.note: Keep the same anchor, stance and range with a stronger band.

ladder.name: Heavy band fly
ladder.note: Use a stronger band without turning it into a bent-elbow press.

exercises.how: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and take a handle in each hand. With a small, fixed bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest, then open slowly without leaning into the band.

exercises.name: Barbell floor press
exercises.how: Lie inside a rack and unrack the bar above your chest, hands just outside shoulder width. Lower with elbows about 45 degrees from your sides until your upper arms touch the floor, then press up without bouncing.

exercises.name: Barbell pullover
exercises.how: Lie along a flat bench with the bar over your chest and a small, fixed bend in your elbows. Lower it behind your head through a comfortable arc, then bring it back without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Decline barbell bench press
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below where the bar touches your chest. Secure your legs on a decline bench and hold the bar above your lower chest. Lower it under control with your forearms upright, then press back up while keeping your shoulders on the bench.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: Secure your legs on a decline bench with the dumbbells beside your lower chest. Press them above your chest, then lower slowly with your wrists stacked over your elbows.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell fly
exercises.how: Secure your legs on a decline bench and hold the dumbbells above your chest. Keep a small bend in your elbows as you open your arms to a comfortable stretch, then bring them together without turning it into a press.

exercises.name: Decline machine chest press
exercises.how: Use a chest press machine designed for a decline pressing path and set the seat so the handles start near your lower chest. Keep your back on the pad as you press forward and slightly down, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Incline cable fly
exercises.how: Set a bench to about 45 degrees between low pulleys. Lie back with a handle in each hand, then sweep your arms together above your upper chest with a fixed soft elbow bend and return slowly.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell fly
exercises.how: Set the bench to a low incline, no more than 30 degrees, and hold the dumbbells above your chest. With a small, fixed elbow bend, open your arms to a comfortable stretch, then bring them together without pressing.

exercises.name: Incline machine chest press
exercises.how: Use a chest press machine designed for an incline pressing path and adjust the seat so the handles start near your upper chest. Keep your back on the pad as you press forward and up, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Smith machine decline press
exercises.how: Secure your legs on a decline bench under the Smith bar and set the safety stops. Unhook the bar, lower it toward your lower chest, then press up without letting your shoulders lift from the bench.

exercises.name: Smith machine incline press
exercises.how: Set the bench to a low incline under the Smith bar and set the safety stops. Unhook the bar, lower it toward your upper chest with your wrists over your elbows, then press up while keeping your shoulders on the pad.

exercises.name: Standing cable chest press
exercises.how: Set both pulleys at chest height and stand in front of them with a staggered stance. Press the handles forward and slightly together, then return slowly while keeping your ribs over your pelvis. You can also sit on an upright bench between the pulleys with your back supported.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.how: Seat set so the handles start at shoulder height. Press up until your arms are nearly straight, then lower.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.how: Stand with the bar at your collarbones, hands just outside shoulder width. Brace, press straight overhead until your arms lock out, then lower to the start.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.how: Stand with dumbbells in front of your shoulders and palms facing you. Press overhead as you turn your palms forward, then reverse slowly without leaning back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.how: Stand with a dumbbell at each shoulder and your ribs down. Press both overhead until your arms are straight, then lower without leaning back. A seated supported setup reduces the trunk demand.

exercises.name: Kettlebell press
exercises.how: Stand tall, or sit tall on the floor with your legs comfortably apart, with a kettlebell racked at one shoulder. Press overhead without leaning back or sideways, then lower to your shoulder. Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: Front raise
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your thighs. Raise one or both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Pike push-ups

ladder.name: Short pike push-ups
ladder.note: hips high, small bend
ladder.how: Place your hands and feet on the floor with your hips high. Bend your elbows a little so your head moves toward a point just ahead of your hands, then press up without resting on your head.

ladder.name: Pike push-ups
ladder.how: From a push-up position, walk your feet in until your hips are high. Lower your head toward a point just ahead of your hands, then press back up without resting on your head.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated pike push-ups
ladder.how: Put your feet on a stable bench or step and lift your hips over your shoulders. Lower your head toward the floor just ahead of your hands, then press up without letting your head bear your weight.

ladder.name: Wall handstand push-ups, partial
ladder.how: Use this version only after you can hold a wall handstand and come down with control. With your back to the wall, bend your elbows only a few inches, then press up while keeping your body tight.

ladder.name: Wall handstand push-ups
ladder.how: Start in a controlled handstand with your back to the wall. Lower slowly with your head moving just ahead of your hands, then press back to straight arms; if your head touches the floor, tap lightly without resting on it. Use the partial version if you cannot control the full descent and press.

exercises.how: Start with hands and feet on the floor and hips high. Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, stopping before it bears weight, then press up. Keep the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.how: Hold the bar end in one hand at your shoulder with feet staggered and ribs down. Press up and forward without twisting, then lower slowly. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Smith machine shoulder press
exercises.how: Set the safety stops just below your lowest position. Seated under the bar with it at collarbone height. Unhook, press overhead to lockout, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Band shoulder press

ladder.name: Light band shoulder press
ladder.note: Use a light band with tension at shoulder height.

ladder.name: Medium band shoulder press
ladder.note: Use a stronger band through the same range.

ladder.name: Heavy band shoulder press
ladder.note: Increase resistance while keeping your torso still.

exercises.how: Stand on a band with a handle at each shoulder. Brace and press your hands overhead, then lower slowly. Keep your ribs down and your feet firmly on the band.

exercises.name: Cable front raise
exercises.how: Face away from a low pulley with the handle in one hand by your thigh. Raise your arm forward to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend, then lower slowly. Keep your torso still and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Cable shoulder press
exercises.how: Stand between two low pulleys with a handle at each shoulder. Brace and press both handles overhead, then lower slowly without leaning back.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell front raise
exercises.how: Sit back on an incline bench with light dumbbells beside your thighs and palms down. Keep a small bend in your elbows as you raise your arms forward to shoulder height. Lower slowly, keeping your back against the bench.

exercises.name: Prone barbell front raise
exercises.how: Lie face down on an incline bench with a light bar hanging beneath your shoulders. Raise the bar forward toward the line of your ears with a soft elbow bend, then lower slowly. Keep your chest on the bench.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows. Raise your arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Upright row
exercises.how: Hold the bar or dumbbells in front of your thighs. Pull close to your body with your elbows moving out and up, stopping at a comfortable height around the lower chest. Lower slowly without shrugging or jerking to force extra range.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.how: Low cable at your side, handle in the far hand. Raise your arm out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Band lateral raise

ladder.name: Light band lateral raises
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band lateral raises
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band lateral raises
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band lateral raises
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Stand on the band, handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band upright row

ladder.name: Light band upright row
ladder.note: Use light resistance and a comfortable chest-height finish.

ladder.name: Medium band upright row
ladder.note: Increase band resistance with the same controlled range.

ladder.name: Heavy band upright row
ladder.note: Increase resistance while keeping the torso still.

ladder.name: Doubled band upright row
ladder.note: Keep the heavy band and add a second band, with the same range.

exercises.how: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends at your thighs. Lead your elbows out and up to a comfortable chest height, then lower slowly without pulling the handles toward your chin.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise hold
exercises.how: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand. Raise your arms out to shoulder height with a soft elbow bend and hold for the seconds shown. Keep your torso still and your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: Front and lateral raise
exercises.how: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and a small bend in your elbows. Raise both weights forward to shoulder height and lower them, then raise them out to your sides and lower again. Keep your body still and alternate the two paths. One front raise and one side raise make one rep.

exercises.name: Side-lying lateral raise
exercises.how: Lie on your side against an incline bench, holding a light dumbbell in your top hand across your body. Raise your arm out to the side toward the ceiling with a small, fixed elbow bend. Lower slowly without rolling your torso.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.how: Set the rope at face height. Pull toward your forehead with elbows high and wide, rotating your hands back beside your ears. Return slowly without shrugging or leaning back.

exercises.name: Rear delt fly
exercises.how: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below you. Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.how: Face the machine, handles in front of you. Open your arms wide, squeezing your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable rear delt fly
exercises.how: Set two pulleys just above shoulder height and take the opposite handle in each hand. Open your arms out and slightly down with a soft elbow bend, then return slowly. Keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.how: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward. Curl them to your shoulders without swinging, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.how: Hold the bar at your thighs with your palms forward, using the angled grips if you have an EZ bar. Curl toward your shoulders without swinging or leaning back, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band curl

ladder.name: Light band curls
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles in your hands. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band curls
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles in your hands. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band curls
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles in your hands. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band curls
ladder.how: Stand on the band, handles in your hands. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Stand on the band, handles in your hands. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing in. Curl to your shoulders keeping the thumbs up, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.how: Sit back on an incline bench with your arms hanging and palms forward. Curl both dumbbells without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly with your wrists straight.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.how: Rest your upper arms on a preacher pad, or one upper arm on an incline bench when using a dumbbell. Curl the weight up, then lower slowly until your elbow is nearly straight, keeping your upper arm on the pad.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.how: Bar on the low cable, elbows at your sides. Curl to your shoulders and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell spider curl
exercises.how: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and palms forward. Curl the bar without lifting your upper arms, then lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Cable preacher curl
exercises.how: Set a preacher bench facing a low cable and rest your upper arms on the pad. Curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower slowly without lifting your elbows or snapping them straight.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.how: Sit with your feet apart and rest the back of one upper arm against your inner thigh. Curl the dumbbell with your palm up, then lower slowly without moving your upper arm.

exercises.name: Drag curl
exercises.how: Hold the bar at your thighs with palms forward. Curl it close to your body while letting your elbows move back, then lower along the same path without shrugging or leaning.

exercises.name: Dumbbell spider curl
exercises.how: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your arms hanging and palms forward. Curl the dumbbells without lifting your upper arms, then lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight.

exercises.name: High cable curl
exercises.how: Stand between two high cables with your upper arms out at shoulder height and palms up. Curl each handle toward your ear, then straighten your elbows slowly without moving your upper arms.

exercises.name: Lying high cable curl
exercises.how: Lie on a bench facing a high pulley and hold the bar above your shoulders with palms toward you. Keep your upper arms still as you curl the bar toward your forehead, then straighten your elbows slowly.

exercises.name: Zottman curl
exercises.how: Curl the dumbbells with palms up and upper arms still. At the top, turn your palms down and lower slowly, then turn them back before the next curl.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.how: Elbows pinned to your sides, grip the bar or rope at chest height. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height.

exercises.name: Skull crusher
exercises.how: Lie on a flat bench with the weight above your shoulders and upper arms still. Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, or dumbbells beside your ears, then straighten your arms without swinging your shoulders.

exercises.name: Triceps dips

ladder.name: Assisted triceps dips
ladder.note: band under the knees
ladder.how: Band under your knees on the bars, body upright. Lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then press up.

ladder.name: Negative triceps dips
ladder.note: lower over 3 seconds
ladder.how: Jump to the top with straight arms, body upright. Lower over 3 seconds, then step down and reset.

ladder.name: Triceps dips
ladder.how: On the bars with your body upright, lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then push back up.

ladder.name: Paused triceps dips
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Lower to 90 degrees at the elbow, hold 2 seconds, then press up.

exercises.how: On the bars with your body upright, lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then push back up.

exercises.name: Bench dips

ladder.name: Bench dips, knees bent
ladder.how: Hands on the bench edge behind you, knees bent and feet flat. Lower your hips toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push up.

ladder.name: Bench dips, legs straight
ladder.how: Hands on the bench, legs straight out in front with heels on the floor. Lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then push up.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated bench dips
ladder.how: Hands on one bench, heels up on another. Lower until your elbows are at 90 degrees, then push up.

ladder.name: Paused feet-elevated bench dips
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Heels on a bench. Lower, hold 2 seconds at the bottom, then push up.

exercises.how: Place your hands on a stable bench edge behind you and keep your hips close to it. Bend your elbows to lower only as far as your shoulders comfortably allow, no deeper than about 90 degrees at the elbows, then press back up.

exercises.name: Close-grip push-ups

ladder.name: Incline close-grip push-ups
ladder.how: Hands close together on a bench or counter, body straight. Lower your chest to your hands with elbows tucked, then press up.

ladder.name: Knee close-grip push-ups
ladder.how: Knees on the floor, hands close together under your chest. Lower with elbows tucked tight, then press up.

ladder.name: Close-grip push-ups
ladder.how: Push-up position with your hands close together under your chest. Lower with elbows tucked tight, then press up.

ladder.name: Paused close-grip push-ups
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Hands close together. Lower, hold 2 seconds just above your hands, then press up.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated close-grip push-ups
ladder.how: Feet on a bench, hands close together. Lower your chest to your hands, elbows tucked, then press up.

exercises.how: Push-up position with your hands close together under your chest. Lower with elbows tucked tight, then press up.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below where the bar touches your chest. Hands just inside shoulder width. Lower the bar to your lower chest with elbows tucked, then press up.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.how: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, or face away from a low cable with a rope behind your head. Keep your upper arms still and bend only your elbows to lower the weight behind your head, then straighten your arms.

exercises.name: Triceps kickback
exercises.how: Hinge forward with your back steady and bring your upper arm beside your torso, roughly parallel to the floor. Keep that upper arm still as you straighten your elbow behind you, pause, and bend it back. Use a light dumbbell without swinging your torso.

exercises.name: Bodyweight triceps extension

ladder.name: Triceps extensions on a counter
ladder.how: Hands on a counter, body straight. Bend only your elbows to lower your head past your hands, then press back up.

ladder.name: Triceps extensions on a low bar or table
ladder.how: Hands on a low bar or table edge, body straight. Bend only your elbows to lower your head past your hands, then press up.

ladder.name: Triceps extensions on the floor
ladder.note: hands on the floor, knees down
ladder.how: Hands on the floor a little ahead of your shoulders, knees down, hips in line. Bend only your elbows to lower your forearms to the floor, then press back to straight arms.

ladder.name: Triceps extensions on the floor, knees up
ladder.how: Hands on the floor a little ahead of your shoulders, knees up, body straight. Bend only your elbows to lower your forearms to the floor, then press back to straight arms.

exercises.how: Hands on an edge, body straight. Bend only your elbows to lower your head past your hands, then press back up.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown

ladder.name: Light band pushdowns
ladder.how: Band anchored high, elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band pushdowns
ladder.how: Band anchored high, elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band pushdowns
ladder.how: Band anchored high, elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band pushdowns
ladder.how: Band anchored high, elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Band anchored high, elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise to chest height.

exercises.name: Band overhead triceps extension

ladder.name: Light band overhead extensions
ladder.note: Stand on a light band and keep the same stance and grip length each set.

ladder.name: Medium band overhead extensions
ladder.note: Use a stronger band with the same setup and controlled range.

ladder.name: Heavy band overhead extensions
ladder.note: Use a heavy band without leaning back or changing upper-arm position.

exercises.how: Stand on the middle of a band and hold its ends behind your head with your elbows pointing up. Straighten your elbows while keeping your upper arms still, then bend them slowly without arching your back.

exercises.name: Band skull crusher

ladder.name: Light band skull crushers
ladder.note: Use a light band secured low behind your head.

ladder.name: Medium band skull crushers
ladder.note: Keep the same anchor, bench position and range with a stronger band.

ladder.name: Heavy band skull crushers
ladder.note: Use a heavier band without moving your upper arms.

exercises.how: Anchor the band low behind the head end of a bench and lie with your upper arms pointing up. Bend your elbows to bring your hands beside your head, then straighten them while keeping your upper arms still.

exercises.name: Cable skull crusher
exercises.how: Set a flat bench with its head end near a low pulley and hold the handle above your shoulders. Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead, then straighten your arms without moving your upper arms.

exercises.name: Ring dips

ladder.name: Feet-assisted ring dips
ladder.note: Set rings low enough to keep your feet on the floor; use your legs to help through a controlled dip.

ladder.name: Negative ring dips
ladder.note: Use your feet to reach the top with the rings steady, lift your feet and lower over 3 seconds; put your feet down to reset.

ladder.name: Ring dips
ladder.note: Keep feet clear, rings close and body still; use a comfortable range to about upper arms parallel with the floor.

ladder.name: Paused ring dips
ladder.note: Hold the bottom of each controlled dip for 2 seconds before pressing up.

exercises.how: Hold a ring beside each hip with your arms straight and the rings close to your body. Lower slowly until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, then press back up while keeping the rings steady.

exercises.name: Single-dumbbell close-grip press
exercises.how: Lie on a flat bench with your feet planted, holding one dumbbell in both hands above your chest. Lower it to your lower chest with your elbows tucked close to your sides, then press it back up.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.how: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand and stand tall with your arms long and shoulders relaxed. Walk with short controlled steps without leaning or swaying, then set the weights down with control. Count the steps.

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.how: Hold the bar with palms facing down. Curl to your shoulders keeping the wrists straight, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse wrist curl
exercises.how: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and hold a light bar palms down, wrists past your knees. Raise the backs of your hands, then lower slowly while keeping your forearms still.

exercises.name: Barbell wrist curl
exercises.how: Sit with your forearms on your thighs and hold a light bar palms up, wrists past your knees. Lower your hands, then curl them up without lifting your forearms or rolling the bar out of your grip.

exercises.name: Cable wrist curl
exercises.how: Sit facing a low cable with the bar held palms up and your forearms resting on your thighs. Let your wrists move down, then curl your hands up without lifting your forearms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse wrist curl
exercises.how: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs, palms down and wrists just past your knees. Raise the backs of your hands, then lower slowly without lifting your forearms.

exercises.name: Dumbbell wrist curl
exercises.how: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms up and wrists just past your knees. Lower your hands, then curl the dumbbells up using only your wrists.

exercises.name: Plate pinch
exercises.how: Pinch two light plates together with their smooth sides out and hold them beside your thigh. Keep them just clear of the floor and set them down before your grip slips; time each hand separately. The weight shown is both plates together.

exercises.name: Wrist roller
exercises.how: Hold the roller in front of you with your arms straight at shoulder height. Turn one wrist at a time to wind the weight up, then unwind it slowly; one full up-and-down trip counts as one rep.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise

ladder.name: Hanging knee tucks
ladder.how: Hang from the bar. Pull your knees up to hip height, then lower slowly without swinging.

ladder.name: Hanging knee raises
ladder.how: Hang from the bar. Draw your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips slightly, then lower slowly without swinging.

ladder.name: Paused hanging knee raises
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Raise your knees to your chest and hold 2 seconds at the top, then lower slowly.

ladder.name: Hanging straight-leg raises
ladder.how: Hang with straight legs. Raise them until they are parallel with the floor, then lower without swinging.

ladder.name: Toes to bar
ladder.how: Hang with straight legs. Raise them all the way until your toes touch the bar, then lower under control.

exercises.how: Hang from the bar with your ribs down. Draw your knees toward your chest and curl your pelvis up slightly, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.how: Kneel facing the cable with the rope held at your forehead. Crunch your elbows toward your knees by curling your spine, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Kettlebell rack carry
exercises.how: Bells racked at your shoulders, elbows in. Stand tall and walk with short steps. Count the steps.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout

ladder.name: Short rollouts
ladder.note: roll to a wall stop
ladder.how: Kneel facing a wall a short distance away so the wheel stops against it. Roll out until it touches, then pull back.

ladder.name: Half rollouts
ladder.how: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders. Roll out until your arms are about 45 degrees, then pull back.

ladder.name: Kneeling rollouts
ladder.how: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders. Roll forward as far as you can keep your lower back from sagging, then pull back to the start.

ladder.name: Paused kneeling rollouts
ladder.note: 2 seconds extended
ladder.how: Roll out as far as you can hold a flat back, pause 2 seconds extended, then pull back.

ladder.name: Standing rollouts
ladder.how: Stand with the wheel at your feet. Roll out toward flat with your back straight, then pull back to standing.

exercises.how: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders. Roll forward as far as you can keep your lower back from sagging, then pull back to the start.

exercises.name: Sit-ups

ladder.name: Crunches
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees bent. Curl your shoulders off the floor a few inches, then lower.

ladder.name: Long-arm crunch
ladder.note: Keep arms beside your ears as the shoulders curl off the floor, without swinging them forward.
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees bent, arms straight past your ears. Curl your shoulders off the floor without swinging your arms forward, then lower.

ladder.name: Sit-ups
ladder.how: Lie on your back with knees bent. Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs, then lower slowly.

ladder.name: Slow sit-ups
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Curl all the way up, then take 3 seconds to lower back down.

ladder.name: Straight-leg sit-ups
ladder.how: Legs straight on the floor. Curl all the way up to sitting, then lower slowly.

ladder.name: Bent-knee V-ups
ladder.note: Curl the shoulders and pelvis together as you tuck both knees, then extend without arching.
ladder.how: Lie flat with arms overhead. Curl your chest up as you draw your bent knees in, meet in the middle, then lower both under control.

ladder.name: V-ups
ladder.how: Lie flat with arms overhead. Fold up so your hands reach toward your feet, legs and torso lifting together, then lower.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with knees bent. Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch

ladder.name: Reverse crunches, knees bent
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat. Curl your knees toward your chest, lifting the hips slightly, then lower.

ladder.name: Reverse crunches
ladder.how: Lie on your back, hands by your hips, knees up. Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly.

ladder.name: Slow reverse crunches
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Curl the hips up, then take 3 seconds to lower them back down.

ladder.name: Straight-leg reverse crunches
ladder.how: Legs straight in the air. Curl the hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower.

ladder.name: Dragon flag negatives
ladder.how: Lie on your back and grip a fixed support behind your head, then raise your hips with your legs straight. Lower your straight body slowly while supported on your shoulders, keeping pressure off your neck. Bend your knees and lower your hips to reset instead of pulling your straight body back up.

exercises.how: Lie on your back, hands by your hips, knees up. Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch

ladder.name: Short cross-body crunch
ladder.note: Keep both feet down and turn one shoulder toward the opposite thigh.

ladder.name: Bent-knee bicycle crunch
ladder.note: Keep the extending knee bent and the foot high.

ladder.name: Bicycle crunch
ladder.note: Extend the opposite leg while turning your shoulder toward the bent knee.

ladder.name: Slow bicycle crunch
ladder.note: Take three seconds to change sides, lowering the leg only with a steady back.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with your shoulders lifted. Turn one shoulder toward the opposite knee as you extend the other leg, then switch slowly without tugging your head; both sides make one rep.

exercises.name: Cable reverse crunch
exercises.how: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low cable, the attachment secured around your ankles and knees bent. Bring your knees in and curl your pelvis off the floor, then lower slowly while keeping tension on the cable.

exercises.name: Low Spiderman plank

ladder.name: Short low Spiderman plank
ladder.note: Hold the low push-up and draw each knee forward a little.

ladder.name: Low Spiderman plank
ladder.note: Bring each knee toward its elbow while keeping the trunk level.

ladder.name: Paused low Spiderman plank
ladder.note: Pause one second with each knee forward.

exercises.how: Hold the bottom of a push-up with elbows bent and your body straight. Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow, return it, then switch without letting your hips twist; both sides make one rep.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise

ladder.name: Bent-knee leg raises
ladder.note: Keep knees bent to shorten the leg lever.

ladder.name: Lying leg raises
ladder.note: Lift and lower nearly straight legs with a steady pelvis.

ladder.name: Slow lying leg raises
ladder.note: Take three seconds to lower without letting your back arch.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with hands by your hips. Lift your nearly straight legs toward vertical, then lower only as far as you can keep your lower back steady; use a flat bench if you prefer.

exercises.name: Plank knee tuck

ladder.name: Short plank knee tucks
ladder.note: Draw the knees partway in with both supports moving together.

ladder.name: Plank knee tucks
ladder.note: Draw the knees under the hips without sagging.

ladder.name: Slow plank knee tucks
ladder.note: Take three seconds to extend the legs and pause before drawing them in.

exercises.how: Start in a high plank with your shins on a ball or feet in suspension straps. Draw your knees toward your chest without letting your back sag, then extend slowly while keeping your shoulders over your hands.

exercises.name: Sit-up press
exercises.how: Lie on your back with knees bent and one light weight held at your chest in both hands. Curl up as you press the weight overhead, then bring it to your chest and lower slowly without jerking.

exercises.name: Suspension fallout

ladder.name: Upright suspension fallout
ladder.note: Stay nearly upright and reach a short distance.

ladder.name: Suspension fallout
ladder.note: Lean farther forward and reach overhead with a rigid trunk.

ladder.name: Long suspension fallout
ladder.note: Use a deeper body lean and pause before returning.

exercises.how: Stand holding the suspension handles with arms straight and lean into them. Reach your arms overhead as your body tips forward, then pull back without letting your ribs flare or lower back sag.

exercises.name: Weighted crunch
exercises.how: Lie on your back with knees bent and a weight held against your chest. Curl your shoulders off the floor while your lower back stays down, pause, then lower slowly without pulling with your neck.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.how: Carry one heavy weight in one hand like a suitcase and walk without leaning. Switch hands halfway.

exercises.name: Russian twist

ladder.name: Russian twists, feet down
ladder.how: Sit leaning back with knees bent and feet on the floor. Rotate to tap the floor beside each hip.

ladder.name: Russian twists, feet up
ladder.how: Sit leaning back with feet lifted off the floor. Rotate to tap the floor beside each hip.

ladder.name: Slow Russian twists
ladder.note: pause each side
ladder.how: Feet lifted. Rotate and pause for a moment at each side before coming back through the middle.

exercises.how: Sit leaning back with knees bent. Rotate your torso to tap the floor beside each hip. One tap each side is one rep.

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
exercises.how: Hold a high cable in both hands with arms long. Turn through your hips and guide it down toward the opposite hip, then return slowly without pulling with your elbows. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Barbell suitcase deadlift
exercises.how: Stand beside the middle of the bar and grip it with one hand. Bend your knees and hips, then stand with both feet planted and your shoulders level. Lower it beside you without twisting or leaning, and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Cable side bend
exercises.how: Stand sideways to a high pulley with the handle held by the near shoulder and your elbow tucked. Bend your ribs down toward that hip without pulling with your arm, then return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side bend
exercises.how: Stand tall holding one weight at your side. Lower it a short distance as you bend toward that side, then use the opposite side of your waist to return upright; keep your hips still and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Heel touches

ladder.name: Short side reaches
ladder.note: Reach partway toward each heel with shoulders just lifted.

ladder.name: Heel touches
ladder.note: Reach to each heel without turning your hips.

ladder.name: Paused heel touches
ladder.note: Pause two seconds at each heel with shoulder blades lifted.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet down and shoulders slightly lifted. Reach sideways toward one heel, then the other, keeping your hips still; touching both sides makes one rep.

exercises.name: Kettlebell windmill
exercises.how: Hold a light bell overhead and turn your feet slightly away from it. Push your hips back as your free hand slides down the opposite leg, keeping the bell stacked above your shoulder, then stand tall without forcing depth.

exercises.name: Landmine rotation
exercises.how: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both arms long and feet wide. Guide it from one side to the other while turning through your hips and feet, keeping your ribs controlled; both sides make one rep.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable chop
exercises.how: Hold a low cable in both hands and start in a small squat facing sideways to it. Stand and turn as you lift the handle across your body above the opposite shoulder, then return slowly and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Renegade row
exercises.how: Start in a wide-foot plank with each hand on a weight that will not roll, like hex dumbbells or kettlebells. Row one weight toward your hip while keeping your hips level, then lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: Side crunch

ladder.name: Short side crunch
ladder.note: Lift the shoulder a little with legs supported.

ladder.name: Side crunch
ladder.note: Curl ribs toward the upper hip without rolling forward.

ladder.name: Paused side crunch
ladder.note: Hold the side curl two seconds.

ladder.name: Side jackknife
ladder.note: Lie on your side and curl the upper ribs toward your hip as you lift the top straight leg; keep the lower leg down.

exercises.how: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and one hand lightly beside your head. Curl your ribs sideways toward your hip, pause, then lower gently and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Standing cable rotation
exercises.how: Stand sideways to a chest-height cable and hold it in both hands with arms long. Turn your rib cage away from the pulley through a comfortable range, then return slowly without yanking your lower back and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Weighted exercise-ball side bend
exercises.how: Rest one side of your waist on an exercise ball with feet braced on the floor and a light weight beside your upper shoulder. Curl your ribs sideways toward your hip, lower slowly, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Overhead carry
exercises.how: Weight pressed overhead, arm locked, ribs down. Walk slowly and count the steps. Switch arms halfway.

exercises.name: Shrug
exercises.how: Weight at arm's length. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, and lower.

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.how: Support one hand on a bench or your knee, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close to your body, then lower all the way. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.how: Grip the bar wider than your shoulders, sit tall. Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leading with your elbows, then let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Pull-ups

ladder.name: Assisted pull-ups
ladder.note: band under a foot, or toes on a chair
ladder.how: Band under one foot or toes on a chair behind you. Pull until your chin clears the bar with the help, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Negative pull-ups
ladder.note: jump to the top, lower over 3 seconds
ladder.how: Jump or step to the top with your chin over the bar. Lower yourself over 3 seconds, then step down and reset.

ladder.name: Pull-ups
ladder.how: Hang from the bar with palms facing away. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Paused pull-ups
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Hang from the bar with palms facing away. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way. 2 seconds at the top.

ladder.name: Chest-to-bar pull-ups
ladder.how: Pull higher than usual so your chest touches the bar at the top, elbows driving down and back, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Side-to-side pull-ups
ladder.note: Use a wide overhand grip, pull toward one hand, lower fully, then alternate without swinging. Both elbows may bend, so this is not a strict archer pull-up.

exercises.how: Hang from the bar with palms facing away. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

exercises.name: Machine-assisted pull-ups
exercises.how: Kneel on the pad, grip the handles. Pull until your chin passes your hands, then lower slowly. On this machine, lower weight means harder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell row
exercises.how: Hinge forward with one hand braced on your knee. Row the kettlebell to your hip, pause, and lower. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Chin-ups

ladder.name: Assisted chin-ups
ladder.note: band under a foot, or toes on a chair
ladder.how: Band under one foot or toes on a chair behind you, palms facing you. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Negative chin-ups
ladder.note: jump to the top, lower over 3 seconds
ladder.how: Jump or step to the top with your chin over the bar, palms facing you. Lower over 3 seconds, then step down and reset.

ladder.name: Chin-ups
ladder.how: Hang with palms facing you, hands shoulder width. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Paused chin-ups
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Hang with palms facing you, hands shoulder width. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way. 2 seconds at the top.

ladder.name: Chest-to-bar chin-ups
ladder.how: Pull high enough that your chest touches the bar, then lower all the way.

ladder.name: Towel-assisted one-arm chin-ups
ladder.note: One hand on the bar, the other on a securely looped towel; lower the assisting hand gradually and train both sides without twisting. Requires a secure towel and bar.

exercises.how: Hang with palms facing you, hands shoulder width. Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.how: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging. Row them to your hips with elbows close, pause, and lower.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.how: Handle at waist height, one hand. Row to your hip without twisting, pause, and reach forward. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Landmine row
exercises.how: Stand beside the bar end, hinge forward, grip it with one hand. Row to your hip, pause, and lower. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.how: Bar at the high cable, arms straight, hinge slightly. Pull the bar down to your thighs in an arc, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Band pulldown

ladder.name: Light band pulldown
ladder.how: Band anchored high. Kneel or sit, pull the handles down to your chest leading with your elbows, and return slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band pulldown
ladder.how: Band anchored high. Kneel or sit, pull the handles down to your chest leading with your elbows, and return slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band pulldown
ladder.how: Band anchored high. Kneel or sit, pull the handles down to your chest leading with your elbows, and return slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band pulldown
ladder.how: Band anchored high. Kneel or sit, pull the handles down to your chest leading with your elbows, and return slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Band anchored high. Kneel or sit, pull the handles down to your chest leading with your elbows, and return slowly.

exercises.name: Incline cable pullover
exercises.how: Lie back on an incline bench facing away from a high cable, holding the bar overhead with a slight elbow bend. Keep that bend fixed as you sweep the bar toward your thighs, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.how: Hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is about 45 degrees, bar hanging below your shoulders. Row to your lower ribs with your elbows slightly out from your sides, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.how: Sit with knees slightly bent, chest up. Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then reach forward under control.

exercises.name: Suspension row

ladder.name: Upright suspension row
ladder.note: body nearly vertical
ladder.how: Stand nearly upright, straps short, body straight. Pull your chest to the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower.

ladder.name: Suspension row
ladder.note: body at 45 degrees
ladder.how: Lean back to about 45 degrees with straight arms, body in a line. Pull your chest to your hands, then lower.

ladder.name: Low suspension row
ladder.note: body nearly flat
ladder.how: Walk your feet forward until your body is nearly flat under the anchor. Pull your chest to the handles, then lower under control.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated suspension row
ladder.how: Feet up on a box, body flat. Pull your chest to the handles and lower slowly.

ladder.name: Single-arm suspension row
ladder.how: One handle, the other hand on your chest. Pull with one arm without twisting your hips, then lower. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Lean back holding the handles with straight arms, body in a line. Pull your chest to your hands, then lower.

exercises.name: Band row

ladder.name: Light band row
ladder.how: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated. Pull the handles to your ribs with elbows tucked, squeeze, and return slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band row
ladder.how: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated. Pull the handles to your ribs with elbows tucked, squeeze, and return slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band row
ladder.how: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated. Pull the handles to your ribs with elbows tucked, squeeze, and return slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band row
ladder.note: keep the heavy band and add a second
ladder.how: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated. Pull the handles to your ribs with elbows tucked, squeeze, and return slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Anchor the band at chest height or loop it around your feet while seated. Pull the handles to your ribs with elbows tucked, squeeze, and return slowly.

exercises.name: Inverted row

ladder.name: Knees-bent inverted row
ladder.how: Lie under a low bar or a heavy table that cannot tip, knees bent and feet flat. Pull your chest up to the edge, then lower.

ladder.name: Inverted row
ladder.how: Lie under a low bar or a heavy table that cannot tip and grip it. Keep your body straight and pull your chest up to it, then lower.

ladder.name: Paused inverted row
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Lie under a low bar or a heavy table that cannot tip and grip it. Keep your body straight, pull your chest up to it, hold 2 seconds, then lower.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated inverted row
ladder.how: Feet up on a chair or bench, body straight. Pull your chest up to the bar, then lower slowly.

ladder.name: Single-arm inverted row
ladder.how: Grip with one hand, the other hand on your chest. Pull your chest to the bar without twisting, then lower. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Lie under a low bar set in a rack, or a heavy table that cannot tip, and grip it. Keep your body straight and pull your chest up to it, then lower.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.how: Straddle the bar and hinge forward with a flat back, holding a close or medium handle. Row to your lower chest with your elbows near your sides, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Y raise
exercises.how: Hinge forward with your back steady and thumbs pointing up. With a small bend in your elbows, raise your arms diagonally forward into a Y, keeping your neck relaxed. Lower slowly without arching your back or turning the movement into a sideways fly. With cables, face two low pulleys and hold the opposite handle in each hand.

exercises.name: Barbell rear delt row
exercises.how: Hinge until your torso is nearly horizontal, holding the bar with a wide overhand grip. Pull toward your upper chest with elbows out at shoulder height, then lower slowly. Keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Chest-supported high dumbbell row
exercises.how: Lie chest-down on a low incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Row with your elbows out until your upper arms line up with your torso, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chest-supported machine row
exercises.how: Set the row machine so your chest rests on the pad and you can reach the handles. Pull toward your lower ribs with your elbows close, squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower without leaving the pad.

exercises.name: High cable row
exercises.how: Kneel a short distance from a high cable holding a rope with both arms extended. Pull toward your upper chest with your elbows out and squeeze your shoulder blades, then reach forward slowly.

exercises.name: Smith machine row
exercises.how: Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the Smith bar below your knees. Unrack it and row toward your lower ribs with your elbows close, then lower under control before racking it.

exercises.name: Two-arm dumbbell row
exercises.how: Hold a weight in each hand and hinge until your torso is nearly level, keeping your back flat. Row both weights toward your lower ribs, squeeze your shoulder blades, and lower without lifting your chest.

exercises.name: Back extension

ladder.name: Partial back extensions
ladder.how: Hips on the pad, feet locked in. Lower only halfway, then raise until your body is in a straight line.

ladder.name: Back extensions
ladder.how: Hips on the pad, feet locked in. Hinge down until your torso is below the pad, then raise it until your body is in a straight line. Do not arch past straight.

ladder.name: Paused back extensions
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Hinge down below the pad, raise to straight, and hold the top for 2 seconds before lowering.

ladder.name: Slow back extensions
ladder.note: 3 seconds each way
ladder.how: Take 3 seconds to lower and 3 seconds to raise, stopping when your body is straight.

exercises.how: Set the pad just below your hip crease and secure your feet. Hinge down at your hips with your back steady, then extend your hips until your body is straight. Stop before arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Rack pull
exercises.how: Set the rack pins at knee height. Grip the bar, brace with a steady back and extend your hips to stand tall, keeping the bar close. Lower to the pins without leaning back at the top.

exercises.name: Seated good morning
exercises.how: Sit on a sturdy box inside a rack with a light bar across your upper back, feet planted and knees apart. Hinge forward through your hips with a steady back, then return upright. Set the safeties just below your controlled range.

exercises.name: Weighted ball back extension
exercises.how: Lie face down over an exercise ball with your feet braced against a wall and a light weight held at your chest. Raise your chest a little by straightening your back, then lower slowly. Stop when your body is in line.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.how: Upper back on the bench, bar across your hips, feet flat. Drive your hips up until your body is level from shoulders to knees, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.how: Ankle strap on a low cable, hands on the frame. Kick the leg straight back, squeeze, and return. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Glute bridge

ladder.name: Glute bridges
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, squeeze, and lower.

ladder.name: Paused glute bridges
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: Drive your hips up to a straight line and hold for 2 seconds, squeezing your glutes, then lower.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated glute bridges
ladder.how: Feet up on a bench or step, knees bent. Drive your hips up until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, then lower.

ladder.name: Single-leg glute bridges
ladder.how: One foot flat, the other leg held straight in the air. Drive up through the planted heel until your hips are level, then lower. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Single-leg feet-elevated glute bridges
ladder.how: One foot on a bench, the other leg in the air. Drive the hips up through the planted heel, squeeze, and lower. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.how: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside your knees. Chest up, push the knees out and the floor away, stand tall, then lower.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.how: Bell between your feet. Hinge down with a flat back, grip it, and stand tall. Lower it the same way.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.how: Face away from a low cable with the rope between your legs. Keep your knees soft and back steady as you hinge your hips back, then drive your hips forward to stand. Let your arms stay long.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.how: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on your hips. Drive your hips up until your body is level from shoulders to knees, squeeze, and lower.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
exercises.how: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and a padded bar across your hips. Lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees line up, then lower slowly without arching your back.

exercises.name: Donkey kick

ladder.name: Donkey kicks
ladder.note: Stop when the thigh lines up with the torso.

ladder.name: Paused donkey kicks
ladder.note: Hold the thigh at body level for two seconds.

ladder.name: Slow donkey kicks
ladder.note: Take three seconds to raise and three seconds to lower.

exercises.how: Start on hands and knees with one knee bent to a right angle. Lift that thigh until it lines up with your torso, keeping your pelvis still, then lower. Do both sides without arching your back.

exercises.name: Prone flutter kicks

ladder.name: Short-range prone flutter kicks
ladder.note: Alternate small lifts just below body level.

ladder.name: Prone flutter kicks
ladder.note: Lift each leg to body level without arching.

ladder.name: Paused prone flutter kicks
ladder.note: Hold each leg at body level for two seconds.

ladder.name: Slow prone flutter kicks
ladder.note: Take three seconds to lift and three seconds to lower each leg.

exercises.how: Lie face down with your hips at the bench edge and hold the bench. Keep your legs straight and lift one toward body level as the other lowers a little. Alternate slowly without arching your back; one lift each side is one rep.

exercises.name: Standing band kickback

ladder.name: Light band kickbacks
ladder.note: Keep the standing knee soft and working knee nearly straight.

ladder.name: Medium band kickbacks
ladder.note: Use a stronger band with the same controlled range.

ladder.name: Heavy band kickbacks
ladder.note: Increase resistance without moving your lower back.

exercises.how: Face a low band anchor with the band around one ankle and hold a support. Move that leg straight back without tipping your pelvis or arching your back, then return slowly. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
exercises.how: Sit with the pads outside your knees. Push your knees apart as far as you can, pause, and return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip adduction machine
exercises.how: Sit with the pads inside your knees. Squeeze your knees together, pause, and open slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge

ladder.name: Supported lateral lunges
ladder.note: hand on a wall
ladder.how: Hand on a wall. Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight, then push back. Alternate.

ladder.name: Lateral lunges
ladder.how: Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight. Push back to standing. Alternate sides.

ladder.name: Deep lateral lunges
ladder.how: Step wide and sit as deep into the hip as you can, chest up, then push back. Alternate.

ladder.name: Paused lateral lunges
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Step wide, sit deep, hold 2 seconds at the bottom, then push back. Alternate.

exercises.how: Step wide to one side and sit into that hip, the other leg straight. Push back to standing. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Barbell lateral split squat
exercises.how: Unrack the bar across your upper back and take a wide stance. Sit toward one foot by bending that knee and hip while the other leg stays nearly straight, then push back to the middle. Keep both feet planted and your back steady.

exercises.name: Cable hip adduction
exercises.how: Fasten a low cable cuff to the ankle nearest the stack and hold the frame for balance. Sweep that leg across in front of the other, keeping your pelvis still, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position. Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out. Sit down between your knees until your thighs are at least parallel, then drive back up through your whole foot.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.how: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot and the pad rests just above your ankles. Straighten your knees, pause, then lower slowly without lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.how: Set the safety stops just below your lowest position. Bar on your upper back, feet slightly in front of you. Unhook, squat until your thighs are parallel, and stand back up.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.how: Stand inside the bar with feet about hip width. Bend your hips and knees to grip the handles, brace with a steady back, then push the floor away and stand tall. Lower under control.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.how: Hold one weight against your chest with both hands. Squat as deep as you comfortably can, elbows inside your knees, then stand up.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.how: Feet shoulder width on the platform. Lower the sled until your knees are at about 90 degrees without letting your lower back lift, then press back out without locking your knees.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge

ladder.name: Supported reverse lunges
ladder.note: hand on a wall
ladder.how: One hand on a wall. Step one foot back and lower that knee toward the floor, front shin upright, then push through the front foot to stand. Alternate.

ladder.name: Reverse lunges
ladder.how: Step one foot back and lower that knee toward the floor, front shin upright. Push through the front foot to stand. Alternate sides.

ladder.name: Deficit reverse lunges
ladder.note: front foot on a step
ladder.how: Front foot on a step. Step back and lower the back knee below the level of the step, then push up through the front foot. Alternate.

ladder.name: Paused deficit reverse lunges
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Front foot on a step. Lower, hold 2 seconds at the bottom, then push up. Alternate.

exercises.how: Step one foot back and lower that knee toward the floor. Push through the front foot to stand, keeping the front knee tracking with the foot. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.how: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid-platform. Lower until your thighs are parallel, then press back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.how: Stand in a long stride with a dumbbell in each hand and both feet on the floor. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through the front foot to stand. Keep the front knee tracking with the foot and do both sides.

exercises.name: Step-ups

ladder.name: Low step-ups
ladder.note: shin-height step
ladder.how: Use a step about shin height. Put your whole foot on it, stand up through that foot, and step down slowly.

ladder.name: Step-ups
ladder.note: knee-height step
ladder.how: Use a step about knee height. Whole foot on it, stand up without pushing off the back foot, step down slowly.

ladder.name: High step-ups
ladder.note: above the knee
ladder.how: Use a step above knee height. Whole foot on it, drive up tall, then step down with control. Switch sides each set.

ladder.name: Slow step-downs
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Knee-height step. Step up normally, then lower the trailing foot to the floor over 3 seconds. Switch sides each set.

exercises.how: Place one whole foot on the box. Push through that foot to stand on top, then step down slowly. Do all reps on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat

ladder.name: Box squats
ladder.note: sit to a chair and stand
ladder.how: Stand in front of a chair, feet shoulder width. Sit back until you touch the seat, then stand straight back up without rocking.

ladder.name: Bodyweight squats
ladder.how: Feet shoulder width, arms out in front for balance. Sit back and down until your thighs are at least parallel, then stand up.

ladder.name: Paused squats
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Squat to at least parallel and hold still for 2 seconds at the bottom, then stand.

ladder.name: Tempo squats
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Take 3 seconds to lower into the squat, then stand up at normal speed.

ladder.name: Cossack squats
ladder.note: wide stance, shift side to side
ladder.how: Wide stance, toes slightly out. Shift all your weight onto one leg and sit into that hip while the other leg stays straight, then push back to centre and switch.

ladder.name: Pistol squats to a box
ladder.how: Stand on one leg in front of a box or chair. Lower under control until you sit, then stand back up on the same leg. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Feet shoulder width, arms out in front for balance. Sit back and down until your thighs are at least parallel, then stand up.

exercises.name: Split squat

ladder.name: Supported split squats
ladder.note: hand on a wall
ladder.how: Long stride stance, one hand on a wall for balance. Lower your back knee toward the floor, front shin upright, then stand. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Split squats
ladder.how: Long stride stance. Lower your back knee toward the floor, front shin upright, then stand. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Walking lunges
ladder.note: Step through into the next lunge; count each lead-leg lunge as one rep.

ladder.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squats
ladder.how: Rear foot up on a bench or chair behind you. Lower until the front thigh is about parallel, then drive up. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Paused rear-foot-elevated split squats
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Rear foot up on a bench. Lower, hold 2 seconds at the bottom, then drive up. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Stand in a long stride with both feet on the floor. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through your front foot to stand. Keep the front knee tracking with the foot and do both sides.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position. Rest the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high. Bend your knees and hips to squat as deep as you can control with your whole feet down, then drive back up while keeping your chest steady.

exercises.name: Barbell box squat
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position. Bar on your back, box behind you. Sit back onto the box under control, pause without relaxing, and stand up.

exercises.name: Kettlebell front squat
exercises.how: Hold one kettlebell at your shoulder in the rack position, elbow tucked and ribs down. Squat as deep as you can control without leaning toward or away from the bell, then stand. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat, dumbbells
exercises.how: Rear foot on the bench, dumbbells at your sides. Lower until your front thigh is parallel, then drive up. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Walking lunge, dumbbells
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides. Step forward into a lunge, lower the back knee toward the floor, then step through into the next one.

exercises.name: Step-ups, dumbbells
exercises.how: Dumbbells at your sides, one whole foot on the box. Stand up through that foot, step down slowly. All reps one side, then switch.

exercises.name: Sissy squat

ladder.name: Supported sissy squats
ladder.note: hold a post, small range
ladder.how: Hold a post or door frame, heels up. Lean back and bend your knees a little, keeping hips straight, then return.

ladder.name: Supported sissy squats, full range
ladder.how: Hold a post, heels up. Lean back and bend your knees as far as you can with hips straight, then return.

ladder.name: Sissy squats
ladder.how: Heels up, knees forward, body in a straight line from knees to shoulders. Lean back and bend the knees as far as you can, then return.

ladder.name: Paused sissy squats
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Lower as far as you can, hold 2 seconds at the bottom, then return.

exercises.how: Heels up, knees forward, body in a straight line from knees to shoulders. Lean back and bend the knees as far as you can, then return.

exercises.name: Band squat

ladder.name: Light band squats
ladder.note: Use light tension and a consistent comfortable depth.

ladder.name: Medium band squats
ladder.note: Use a stronger band with the same stance and depth.

ladder.name: Heavy band squats
ladder.note: Increase resistance without shortening the squat.

ladder.name: Doubled-band squats
ladder.note: Keep the heavy band from the previous level and add a second band, using the same stance and squat depth.

exercises.how: Stand on the middle of a band with your feet about shoulder width apart and hold the ends by your shoulders. Squat as low as you comfortably can with your heels down, then stand without letting your knees cave in.

exercises.name: Barbell Bulgarian split squat
exercises.how: Unrack the bar across your upper back and rest one foot behind you on a low bench. Bend your front knee and hip to lower under control, then push through the front foot to stand. Keep your pelvis level and finish one side before switching.

exercises.name: Barbell deficit reverse lunge
exercises.how: Unrack the bar across your upper back and stand on a stable low step. Step one foot back to the floor and lower the back knee below the step as far as you can control. Push through your front foot to return, keeping your pelvis level.

exercises.name: Barbell lunge
exercises.how: Unrack the bar across your upper back and step forward into a lunge. Lower your back knee toward the floor, then push through your front foot to return. Keep your pelvis level and let the front knee follow your toes.

exercises.name: Barbell step-up
exercises.how: Unrack the bar across your upper back and face a stable low box. Plant one whole foot on it and stand through that leg, then step down slowly. Keep your pelvis level and avoid pushing off the trailing foot.

exercises.name: Behind-the-back barbell squat
exercises.how: Hold the bar behind your legs with straight arms. Bend your knees and hips to lower it close behind your calves, then push through your whole feet to stand. Keep your back steady and use only the depth the bar can clear.

exercises.name: Belt squat
exercises.how: Stand on two sturdy, matching raised platforms with a dip belt holding weight between them. Keep both feet flat as you squat to a comfortable depth, then stand. Leave room for the weight to hang freely without swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squat
exercises.how: Hold a dumbbell at each side with your feet about shoulder width apart. Bend your hips and knees to squat as low as you can with your whole feet down, then stand. Let your knees travel naturally in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Pistol squat, kettlebell
exercises.how: Hold a light kettlebell in front of your chest and lift one foot. Squat on the standing leg as low as you can with your heel down, then stand. Start with a short range and keep the knee tracking with the foot.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge, dumbbells
exercises.how: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step one foot back. Lower that knee toward the floor, then push through your front foot to stand. Keep your front knee tracking with your toes and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Smith machine Bulgarian split squat
exercises.how: Set the Smith safeties and place the bar on your upper back with your rear foot on a bench. Lower until the front thigh is about parallel, then push through the front foot to stand. Repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Smith machine single-leg squat
exercises.how: Set the Smith safeties, place the bar on your upper back and lift one foot in front. Bend your standing hip and knee through a comfortable range, then stand. Keep the whole working foot planted and do both sides.

exercises.name: Zercher squat
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position. Set the bar in a rack around waist height and cradle it in the bends of your elbows. Hold it close as you squat between your knees, then push through your whole feet to stand. Keep your chest steady and your arms tucked against your body.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.how: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside your legs, flat back, chest up. Push the floor away and stand tall with the bar close to your legs, then lower it the same way.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.how: Pad just above your heels. Curl your heels toward your glutes, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Hold the bar at your hips. Push your hips back and lower the bar down your legs with a flat back and soft knees until you feel your hamstrings, then stand up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Dumbbells in front of your thighs. Push your hips back, keeping the weights close to your legs and your back flat, until your hamstrings stretch. Stand up by squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift

ladder.name: Supported single-leg RDL
ladder.note: hand on a wall
ladder.how: Stand on one leg with a hand on a wall. Hinge forward with a flat back, letting the free leg float back, then stand. Do both sides.
