ladder.name: Single-leg RDL
ladder.how: Balance on one leg. Hinge forward with a flat back, letting the other leg float behind you, until your torso is near horizontal. Stand back up. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Paused single-leg RDL
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Hinge until your torso is near horizontal, hold 2 seconds, then stand. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Slow single-leg RDL
ladder.note: 3 seconds down
ladder.how: Take 3 seconds to hinge down, then stand at normal speed. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Balance on one leg. Hinge forward with a flat back, letting the other leg float behind you, until your torso is near horizontal. Stand back up. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.how: Set the rack safeties just below your lowest position. Bar on your upper back, soft knees. Push your hips back and fold forward with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings, then stand.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift, dumbbell
exercises.how: One leg, weight in the opposite hand. Hinge forward with a flat back, letting the free leg float back, then stand. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Nordic curl

ladder.name: Assisted Nordic curls
ladder.note: hands assist on the floor; a band anchored behind you is optional
ladder.how: Kneel with your ankles securely held and knees padded, keeping your hips straight. Use your hands on the floor to support as much weight as needed while lowering and returning. If you use a band instead, secure it behind you above shoulder height and loop it around your chest below your armpits, keeping your hands ready to catch you.

ladder.name: Nordic negatives
ladder.note: lower slowly, push back up
ladder.how: Kneel with feet anchored, hips straight. Lower your body forward as slowly as you can all the way to the floor, catch yourself with your hands, and push back up.

ladder.name: Nordic curls, partial
ladder.how: Lower only halfway before pulling yourself back up with your hamstrings.

ladder.name: Nordic curls
ladder.how: Kneel with your feet anchored under something heavy that cannot lift, like a couch, or held by a partner. Keep your hips straight and lower your body forward as slowly as you can, then pull back up.

ladder.name: Paused nordic curls
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Lower all the way, hold 2 seconds just above the floor, then pull back up.

exercises.how: Kneel with your ankles held securely and knees padded. Keep your hips straight as you lower forward slowly, then curl back with your hamstrings. Use your hands to catch and help the return when needed.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise

ladder.name: Glute-ham raise negatives
ladder.how: Start at the top, body straight. Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can, then push off the pad to return.

ladder.name: Assisted glute-ham raises
ladder.note: hands push off the pad
ladder.how: Lower to horizontal, then push lightly off the pad with your hands to help the hamstrings curl you back up.

ladder.name: Glute-ham raises
ladder.how: Feet locked in, knees on the pad. Lower your torso forward until it is horizontal, then curl yourself back up with your hamstrings.

ladder.name: Paused glute-ham raises
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the bottom
ladder.how: Lower to horizontal, hold 2 seconds, then curl back up.

exercises.how: Feet locked in, knees on the pad. Lower your torso forward until it is horizontal, then curl yourself back up with your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Band good morning

ladder.name: Light band good mornings
ladder.how: Stand on the band with it across your upper back, below your neck. Push your hips back and fold forward with a flat back, then stand. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band good mornings
ladder.how: Stand on the band with it across your upper back, below your neck. Push your hips back and fold forward with a flat back, then stand. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band good mornings
ladder.how: Stand on the band with it across your upper back, below your neck. Push your hips back and fold forward with a flat back, then stand. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band good mornings
ladder.how: Stand on the band with it across your upper back, below your neck. Push your hips back and fold forward with a flat back, then stand. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Stand on a loop band with the other end across your upper back, away from your neck. Soften your knees and push your hips back with your back steady, then extend your hips to stand.

exercises.name: Cable deadlift
exercises.how: Stand between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand. Bend your hips and knees to lower, then push through your feet to stand tall with your arms long and back steady.

exercises.name: Exercise ball leg curl

ladder.name: Ball curl negatives
ladder.note: Start with knees bent and hips lifted, then slowly straighten your legs only as far as you can control; lower your hips to reset.

ladder.name: Ball leg curls
ladder.note: Keep hips lifted for both directions.

ladder.name: Paused ball leg curls
ladder.note: Pause for two seconds with knees curled and hips lifted.

ladder.name: Single-leg ball leg curls
ladder.note: Use one heel on the ball; do both sides.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with your heels on the ball. Lift your hips, curl the ball toward you, then straighten your legs slowly without letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: Seated band leg curl

ladder.name: Light band seated curls
ladder.note: Keep band tension through the curl.

ladder.name: Medium band seated curls
ladder.note: Stronger band without moving the thighs.

ladder.name: Heavy band seated curls
ladder.note: Increase resistance and control the return.

exercises.how: Sit on a bench facing a low band anchor with the band secured around your ankles. Keep your thighs still and curl your heels under the bench, then straighten your knees slowly without letting the band go slack.

exercises.name: Sliding leg curl

ladder.name: Bridge slide-out negatives
ladder.note: Lift your hips and slide both heels away slowly only as far as you can control; lower your hips before resetting.

ladder.name: Sliding leg curls
ladder.note: Keep hips lifted while sliding both heels out and in.

ladder.name: Single-leg sliding curls
ladder.note: Use one heel with the other leg raised; do both sides.

exercises.how: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor. Lift your hips, slide your heels away slowly, then curl them back without dropping your hips. If you cannot keep the bridge, use a short slide-out negative and lower your hips to reset.

exercises.name: Smith machine Romanian deadlift
exercises.how: Set the bar near thigh height and stand so it stays close to your legs. Unhook it, soften your knees and push your hips back until your hamstrings stretch, then stand. Keep your back steady and set the safety stops.

exercises.name: Calf raise

ladder.name: Calf raises on the floor
ladder.how: Stand on the floor, feet hip width. Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, pause, and lower.

ladder.name: Calf raises on an edge
ladder.how: Stand on the balls of your feet on an edge. Rise as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels below the edge.

ladder.name: Paused calf raises on an edge
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: On an edge, rise as high as you can and hold 2 seconds at the top, then lower your heels below the edge.

ladder.name: Single-leg calf raises
ladder.how: One foot on the edge, the other tucked behind. Rise as high as you can, then lower the heel below the edge. Do both sides.

ladder.name: Paused single-leg calf raises
ladder.note: 2 seconds at the top
ladder.how: One foot on the edge. Rise, hold 2 seconds at the top, then lower below the edge. Do both sides.

exercises.how: Stand on the balls of your feet on an edge. Rise as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels below the edge.

exercises.name: Calf raise, dumbbells
exercises.how: Hold dumbbells at your sides and use a stable low edge with the balls of both feet firmly supported. Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower your heels slowly. Use the floor until you can keep your balance.

exercises.name: Calf raise on the leg press
exercises.how: Balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform, legs nearly straight. Press through your toes, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band calf raise

ladder.name: Light band calf raises
ladder.note: Use light tension throughout the movement.

ladder.name: Medium band calf raises
ladder.note: Use a stronger band with the same stance and range.

ladder.name: Heavy band calf raises
ladder.note: Keep the same controlled ankle range with more tension.

ladder.name: Doubled-band calf raises
ladder.note: Keep the heavy band from the previous level and add a second band, using the same foot position and controlled ankle range.

exercises.how: Stand on the middle of a band with the balls of your feet and hold the ends by your shoulders. Rise onto your toes, pause, then lower your heels slowly without letting the band slip.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise machine
exercises.how: Sit with the pad resting on your lower thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Release the safety, lower your heels slowly, then raise them as high as you can while keeping your knees bent.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise, dumbbell
exercises.how: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell resting on one thigh just above your knee. Keep your knee bent, raise that heel as high as you can, then lower slowly. Use a fixed low edge for more range and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Standing loaded calf raise
exercises.how: Set the machine pads or racked bar on your upper back and keep your knees nearly straight. Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower your heels slowly. Use a stable edge and set the safeties before unracking a bar.

exercises.name: Tibialis raise

ladder.name: Supported toe raises
ladder.note: Stand upright with heels planted and hold a fixed support.

ladder.name: Wall-lean toe raises
ladder.note: Lean your back against a wall with feet a little forward; keep heels down as you lift toes.

ladder.name: Long-lever wall toe raises
ladder.note: Move your feet farther from the wall while keeping a straight body and heels planted.

ladder.name: Single-leg wall toe raises
ladder.note: Use one heel at a time with the same controlled range; do both sides.

exercises.how: Stand with your heels planted and hold a fixed support for balance. Lift the balls of your feet and toes toward your shins, then lower slowly. Keep your knees still and use a wall lean as the movement gets easier.

exercises.name: Barbell push press
exercises.how: Start with the bar at your shoulders and brace. Dip slightly at the knees, then drive through your legs and press overhead in one motion. Finish with straight legs and arms, then lower to your shoulders under control. Stop the set when the reps slow down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell jerk
exercises.how: Start with a kettlebell racked at one shoulder. Dip your knees and drive up, then bend them again to catch the bell with your arm straight overhead. Stand tall before lowering to the rack; keep your trunk steady and learn the timing with a light bell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell push press
exercises.how: Hold a kettlebell at each shoulder and brace your middle. Bend your knees a little, then drive through your legs and press both bells overhead without dipping a second time. Lower to your shoulders under control before the next rep. Stop the set when the reps slow down.

exercises.name: Landmine push press
exercises.how: Hold the bar end at one shoulder with your feet about shoulder width. Dip slightly at the knees, then drive through your legs and press up and forward. Lower under control and repeat on the other side. Stop the set when the reps slow down.

exercises.name: Medicine ball slam

ladder.name: Light ball slams
ladder.how: Use the lightest ball. Raise it overhead, slam it down by folding at the hips, pick it up and repeat.

ladder.name: Ball slams
ladder.how: Raise the ball overhead, then slam it into the floor as hard as you can by folding at the hips. Pick it up and repeat.

ladder.name: Heavy ball slams
ladder.how: Use a heavier ball. Raise it overhead, slam it down as hard as you can, pick it up and repeat.

exercises.how: Lift a slam ball overhead, then throw it into the floor as hard as you can, folding at the hips. Let it settle, pick it up with a steady back and reset before the next one. Stop the set when the reps slow down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.how: Hike the bell back between your legs, then snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height. Arms stay relaxed; the hips do the work. Stop the set when the reps slow down.

exercises.name: Broad jump

ladder.name: Short broad jumps
ladder.note: Jump forward about one shoe length, landing on both feet and holding still for two seconds.

ladder.name: Broad jumps
ladder.note: Use an arm swing to jump a comfortable longer distance; keep the same controlled landing and reset each rep rather than reaching your feet out for a distance record.

ladder.name: Linked short broad jumps
ladder.note: Link short two-foot forward jumps with controlled rebounds; keep distances below your single-jump maximum and stop if landings change.

exercises.how: Stand with your feet hip width apart and a clear, level landing area ahead. Dip at your hips and knees, swing your arms and jump forward from both feet. Land on both feet with soft knees and settle before your next jump.

exercises.name: Dumbbell clean
exercises.how: Start with light dumbbells beside your feet, hips back and back flat. Drive through your legs and hips, then guide the weights to your shoulders as you bend into a squat. Stand tall, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
exercises.how: Hinge back with one bell hanging between your legs and your back flat. Drive through your hips, keeping the bell close, and let it wrap softly onto your forearm at shoulder height. Lower to the hang and repeat on both sides.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean and jerk
exercises.how: Hinge to clean one kettlebell into the rack at your shoulder. Dip your knees and drive upward, then bend them again to receive the bell with your arm straight overhead. Stand tall, lower the bell and repeat the clean; keep your trunk braced and practise each part with a light bell first.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch
exercises.how: Hinge and hike a kettlebell back between your legs. Drive your hips forward to send it upward, keeping it close, then slide your hand through the handle to finish with the bell resting softly behind your wrist overhead. Lower under control into the next hinge; learn the catch with a light bell first.

exercises.name: Lateral bound

ladder.name: Two-foot lateral jumps, stick the landing
ladder.note: From two feet, make a small sideways jump and land on both feet with soft knees. Hold still for two seconds before returning; practise both directions.

ladder.name: Short lateral bounds, stick the landing
ladder.note: Take a small hop from one foot to the other sideways; hold each landing for two seconds before returning.

ladder.name: Lateral bounds, stick the landing
ladder.note: Bound a comfortable stride sideways and hold each landing for two seconds; increase travel only while your knee and pelvis stay controlled.

ladder.name: Continuous lateral bounds
ladder.note: Alternate sides with a small, controlled rebound instead of the two-second hold; stop when you cannot control the next landing.

exercises.how: Stand with your hips and knees slightly bent. Push off sideways and land with your knee over your toes and your pelvis level, settling before the next jump. Your level sets whether you jump from two feet or one, how far and how fast.

exercises.name: Box jump

ladder.name: Low box jumps
ladder.note: Use a stable box about 10-15 cm high; land on both feet, stand and step down before each new jump.

ladder.name: Box jumps
ladder.note: Use a stable box about 20-30 cm high only when you can keep the same balanced, softly bent landing; step down and reset. Do not gain height by tucking into a deep squat.

exercises.how: Face a low, stable box with your feet hip width apart. Dip, swing your arms and jump onto it, landing on both feet with your knees tracking your toes. Stand tall, step down and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Single-leg hop

ladder.name: Small single-leg hops in place
ladder.note: Hop only just clear of the floor on one foot and settle for two seconds after each landing; do both sides.

ladder.name: Forward single-leg hops, stick the landing
ladder.note: Hop a short distance forward on the same foot, holding each landing for two seconds; do both sides.

ladder.name: Repeated forward single-leg hops
ladder.note: Link small forward hops on the same foot without the hold, keeping the landings controlled; do both sides.

exercises.how: Balance on one leg with a soft knee. Dip and hop a short distance forward, landing on the same foot with your knee over your toes. Settle before the next hop unless your level calls for a rebound; do both sides.

exercises.name: Wall handstand hold

ladder.name: Pike hold
ladder.note: hips high, hands on the floor
ladder.how: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high in an upside-down V. Push the floor away and hold.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated pike hold
ladder.how: Feet on a bench, hips stacked over the shoulders. Push the floor away and hold.

ladder.name: Wall handstand hold, chest to wall, partial
ladder.how: Walk your feet up the wall until your chest is near it, body at an angle. Hold.

ladder.name: Wall handstand hold
ladder.how: Kick up into a handstand against the wall, body straight, pushing tall through the shoulders. Hold.

exercises.how: Hands shoulder width, a short step out from a wall. Kick or walk up until your heels rest on the wall, arms locked and body straight. Push the floor away and hold for the seconds shown. Come down one foot at a time before your arms tire.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart

ladder.name: Light band pull-aparts
ladder.how: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly. Use a light band.

ladder.name: Medium band pull-aparts
ladder.how: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly. Use a medium band.

ladder.name: Heavy band pull-aparts
ladder.how: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly. Use a heavy band.

ladder.name: Doubled band pull-aparts
ladder.how: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly. Keep the heavy band and add a second band.

exercises.how: Hold the band in front of you at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull your hands apart until the band touches your chest, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Dead bug

ladder.name: Dead bug, arms only
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees over hips, arms straight up. Keep the legs still and lower one arm overhead, lower back pressed down, then return and switch.

ladder.name: Dead bug, legs only
ladder.how: Lie on your back, arms straight up. Keep the arms still and lower one heel toward the floor without arching your back, then return and switch.

ladder.name: Dead bug
ladder.how: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees over hips. Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor while your lower back stays pressed down. Return and switch.

ladder.name: Slow dead bug
ladder.note: 3 seconds to extend, pause, 3 seconds to return
ladder.how: Take 3 seconds to extend the arm and opposite leg, pause, and 3 seconds to return. Switch.

ladder.name: Dead bug with heel taps
ladder.note: leg fully extended
ladder.how: Extend the leg fully and tap the heel on the floor while the opposite arm reaches overhead, back flat, then switch.

exercises.how: Lie on your back, arms straight up, knees over hips. Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor while your lower back stays pressed down. Return and switch.

exercises.name: Plank

ladder.name: Knee plank
ladder.how: Forearms and knees on the floor, body straight from head to knees. Brace and hold.

ladder.name: Plank
ladder.how: Forearms down, body in a straight line from head to heels. Brace as if about to be punched and hold for the seconds shown.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated plank
ladder.how: Feet up on a bench, forearms on the floor, body straight. Brace and hold.

ladder.name: Long-lever plank
ladder.note: elbows ahead of your shoulders
ladder.how: Forearms on the floor but elbows ahead of your shoulders. Keep the hips level and hold.

exercises.how: Forearms down, body in a straight line from head to heels. Brace as if about to be punched and hold for the seconds shown.

exercises.name: Hollow hold

ladder.name: Tuck hold
ladder.note: knees pulled in
ladder.how: Lie on your back, pull your knees to your chest and lift your shoulders. Lower back pressed down. Hold.

ladder.name: Bent-knee hollow hold
ladder.how: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet lifted, shoulders off the floor, lower back pressed down. Hold.

ladder.name: Hollow hold
ladder.how: Lie on your back, lower back pressed into the floor, shoulders and legs lifted a few inches. Hold for the seconds shown.

ladder.name: Hollow rocks
ladder.note: count the seconds
ladder.how: From the hollow position, rock gently back and forth without losing the shape. Count the seconds.

exercises.how: Lie on your back, lower back pressed into the floor, shoulders and legs lifted a few inches. Hold for the seconds shown.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.how: Stand side-on to the cable with the handle at your chest. Press it straight out and hold without letting it pull you around, then bring it back. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Side plank

ladder.name: Knee side plank
ladder.how: On one forearm, knees bent and stacked. Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to knees and hold. Switch sides.

ladder.name: Side plank
ladder.how: On one forearm, feet stacked, hips lifted so your body is a straight line. Hold for the seconds shown, then switch sides.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated side plank
ladder.how: On one forearm, feet up on a bench. Lift the hips to a straight line and hold. Switch sides.

ladder.name: Side plank with leg raise
ladder.how: Side plank on the feet. Raise the top leg and hold it there for the time. Switch sides.

exercises.how: On one forearm, feet stacked, hips lifted so your body is a straight line. Hold for the seconds shown, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Kettlebell figure eight
exercises.how: Stand wide and hinge slightly with a steady back. Pass one bell between your legs from hand to hand in a figure eight, keeping your chest and hips facing forward; a full loop makes one rep.

exercises.name: Turkish get-up
exercises.how: Start on your back with one knee bent and the same-side arm holding the bell above your shoulder. Roll to your other elbow, press to your hand, lift your hips and sweep your straight leg back to kneel. Keep the bell stacked as you stand from the lunge, then reverse each step; practise the stages without weight first.

exercises.name: Band shoulder external rotation

ladder.name: Light band external rotation
ladder.note: Use a light band; keep the elbow still.

ladder.name: Medium band external rotation
ladder.note: Increase band resistance without rotating your torso.

ladder.name: Heavy band external rotation
ladder.note: Use stronger resistance only through the same controlled range.

exercises.how: Anchor a light band at elbow height and hold it in the far hand. Keep your elbow bent and tucked to your side as you rotate your hand outward, then return slowly. Keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Cable shoulder external rotation
exercises.how: Set a pulley at elbow height and hold the handle in the far hand. With your elbow bent and tucked to your side, rotate your hand outward, then return slowly. Keep your torso still.

exercises.name: Chest-supported scapular retraction
exercises.how: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with the weights hanging and your arms straight. Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows or lifting your shoulders toward your ears, then release slowly.

exercises.name: Prone dumbbell external rotation
exercises.how: Lie face down with one upper arm out to the side and your elbow bent 90 degrees. Keep the upper arm level and rotate the dumbbell forward and up, then lower slowly without shrugging.

exercises.name: Scapular pull-ups

ladder.name: Foot-assisted scapular pull-ups
ladder.note: Keep some weight on your feet using a low bar or secure support; maintain straight elbows.

ladder.name: Scapular pull-ups
ladder.note: Full hanging bodyweight through the small controlled shoulder-blade range.

ladder.name: Paused scapular pull-ups
ladder.note: Pause for two seconds with shoulders down, without bending the elbows.

exercises.how: Hang from the bar with straight elbows. Draw your shoulders down away from your ears to lift your body a few centimetres, pause, then return slowly without bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Side-lying dumbbell external rotation
exercises.how: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to a right angle and tucked against your ribs. Hold a light dumbbell and rotate your forearm upward without rolling your body or lifting your elbow. Lower slowly through the same arc.

exercises.name: Wall slides
exercises.how: Back against a wall, arms in a goalpost shape touching the wall. Slide them up and down keeping contact.

exercises.name: Bird dog

ladder.name: Bird dog, arm only
ladder.how: On hands and knees. Reach one arm forward without letting your hips tilt, return, and switch.

ladder.name: Bird dog, leg only
ladder.how: On hands and knees. Reach one leg straight back without arching, return, and switch.

ladder.name: Bird dog
ladder.how: On hands and knees. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back without letting your hips tilt, return, and switch.

ladder.name: Paused bird dog
ladder.note: 3 seconds extended
ladder.how: Extend the arm and opposite leg, hold still for 3 seconds, then return and switch.

ladder.name: Bird dog with elbow-to-knee
ladder.how: Extend the arm and opposite leg, then bring the elbow and knee together under your body, extend again, and switch.

exercises.how: On hands and knees. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back without letting your hips tilt, return, and switch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge march

ladder.name: Glute bridge marches
ladder.how: Hold a glute bridge. Lift one foot off the floor without letting your hips drop, replace it, and switch. One lift each side is one rep.

ladder.name: Slow glute bridge marches
ladder.note: 3 seconds each lift
ladder.how: Hold the bridge and take 3 seconds to lift each foot and 3 seconds to replace it, hips level.

ladder.name: Feet-elevated glute bridge marches
ladder.how: Feet on a bench, hips up. March one foot off the bench at a time without the hips dropping.

exercises.how: Hold a glute bridge. Lift one foot off the floor without letting your hips drop, replace it, and switch. One lift each side is one rep.

exercises.name: Glute bridge hold
exercises.how: Lie on your back, knees bent. Lift your hips and hold them up, squeezing your glutes.

exercises.name: Monster walk

ladder.name: Knee-band monster walks
ladder.note: Light band above the knees only.

ladder.name: Ankle-band monster walks
ladder.note: Move the band to the ankles for a longer hip lever.

ladder.name: Two-band monster walks
ladder.note: Use light bands above your knees and around your ankles.

ladder.name: Stronger-band monster walks
ladder.note: Keep both bands and make one of them heavier.

exercises.how: Loop a light band above your knees and stand with your feet apart and knees slightly bent, keeping light tension. Take short controlled steps forward, then backward, keeping your knees apart and pelvis level. Count each foot placement as one step.

exercises.name: Standing band hip abduction

ladder.name: Light band hip abduction
ladder.note: Use a light band with your pelvis still.

ladder.name: Medium band hip abduction
ladder.note: Increase resistance with the same range.

ladder.name: Heavy band hip abduction
ladder.note: Use a stronger band without leaning or swinging.

exercises.how: Anchor a band low on the side opposite your working leg and loop it around your ankle. Hold a support, move the leg out to the side without leaning, then return slowly. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Wall sit

ladder.name: Wall sit, high
ladder.note: thighs above parallel
ladder.how: Back flat against a wall, slide down until your thighs are a little above parallel. Hold.

ladder.name: Wall sit
ladder.how: Back flat against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor, knees over ankles. Hold for the seconds shown.

ladder.name: Wall sit with heels raised
ladder.how: Thighs parallel, heels raised off the floor. Hold.

ladder.name: Single-leg wall sit
ladder.how: Thighs parallel, one foot lifted a few inches. Hold, then switch legs.

exercises.how: Back flat against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor, knees over ankles. Hold for the seconds shown.

exercises.name: Backward sled drag
exercises.how: Face the sled and hold its straps with your arms long. Lean back slightly and walk backward with short, steady steps, straightening each knee as you pull.

exercises.name: Forward sled drag
exercises.how: Face away from the sled and hold its tow straps just behind your hips, with enough space for the sled to clear your heels. Lean forward slightly and walk with short, steady steps while keeping your trunk firm. Use a light load that lets you keep moving smoothly for the interval.

exercises.name: Kettlebell sumo high pull
exercises.how: Stand wide with a kettlebell between your feet, push your hips back and take the handle in both hands with your back flat. Drive through your feet to stand, letting your elbows lead up and out so the bell rises to chest height. Lower it under control and go again.

exercises.name: Kettlebell thruster
exercises.how: Rack a kettlebell at each shoulder and squat as low as you can control. Stand powerfully and use that drive to press the bells overhead. Lower to your shoulders before the next squat, keeping your ribs over your hips.

exercises.name: Landmine thruster
exercises.how: Hold the bar end in both hands at your chest and squat down with your chest up. Drive through your feet to stand and press the bar up and forward in one motion, then lower to your chest. Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: Mountain climbers

ladder.name: Slow mountain climbers
ladder.note: Move one foot at a time, setting it back before the other knee comes forward; keep hips still.

ladder.name: Running mountain climbers
ladder.note: Switch legs with a small hop, keeping your hands planted and hips level; use a controlled rhythm and stop when the plank shape changes.

exercises.how: Start with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Bring one knee toward your chest, return it and switch legs at the pace shown for your level. Keep your hips low and steady rather than bouncing them up.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.how: Grip the sled handles with your arms long and lean forward with a firm trunk. Push through the ground with short, steady steps, driving through your hips and knees. Keep the same controlled pace as you add weight.

exercises.name: Chest-opening arm swings
exercises.how: Stand with your arms reaching forward and palms together. Slowly open your arms out and a little behind you, then bring your hands together again. Repeat without bouncing or forcing your shoulders back.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.how: Stand in a doorway and rest one forearm on the frame with the elbow at shoulder height. Step slowly through with the same-side foot until the front of your chest and shoulder stretch, keeping that shoulder down and away from your ear. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Kettlebell halo
exercises.how: Hold a light kettlebell by its horns in front of your chest. Slowly circle it close around your head, keeping your ribs down and your head still. Change direction halfway and keep the motion comfortable.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.how: Stand with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height. Make small, slow circles, keeping your shoulders relaxed, and reverse direction halfway through.

exercises.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
exercises.how: Bring one arm across your chest at shoulder height. Support the upper arm with your other hand and ease it closer until the back of your shoulder stretches, keeping the shoulder down. Hold, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Standing biceps stretch
exercises.how: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back with your arms softly straight. Ease your hands a little away from your hips until the front of your arms and chest stretches, keeping your shoulders low. Hold without forcing your arms higher.

exercises.name: Overhead triceps stretch
exercises.how: Raise one arm overhead and bend its elbow so your hand rests behind your head. Use your other hand to steady the upper arm and ease it slightly back, keeping your ribs down. Hold gently, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Kneeling wrist and forearm stretch
exercises.how: Kneel with your palms down and fingers pointing toward your knees, only as far around as feels comfortable. Ease your hips back slightly until the front of your forearms stretches, keeping your palms lightly grounded. Hold without forcing your wrists.

exercises.name: Wrist circles
exercises.how: Hold your hands comfortably in front of you with your elbows relaxed. Slowly circle both wrists through an easy range, then change direction halfway through. Keep the movement in your wrists rather than your whole arms.

exercises.name: Standing side stretch
exercises.how: Stand with your feet comfortably apart and one hand on your hip. Lift your other elbow beside your head and lean gently away from that side, keeping your hips still. Hold without twisting, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Standing torso twist
exercises.how: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms crossed over your chest. Slowly turn your chest to one side, then the other, keeping your hips facing forward. Let the turn grow a little each time without swinging hard.

exercises.name: Shoulder rolls
exercises.how: Let your arms hang loosely at your sides. Slowly roll your shoulders forward, up, back and down, then reverse direction halfway through. Keep the circles easy and your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Side neck stretch
exercises.how: Sit or stand tall and let both shoulders relax down. Gently tip one ear toward that shoulder until the other side of your neck and shoulder stretches. Hold without pulling on your head, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Feet-supported one-arm hang
exercises.how: Hold a pull-up bar with one hand and keep both feet firmly supported on the floor or a secure step. Bend your knees a little to ease part of your weight into that arm, keeping enough weight on your feet to stay comfortable. Hold, then switch arms.

exercises.name: Overhead arm swings
exercises.how: Stand tall and slowly swing both arms forward and overhead, then lower them again. Gradually use a comfortable range while keeping your ribs down and your lower back still.

exercises.name: Wall lat stretch
exercises.how: Stand beside a wall with one bent elbow above shoulder height and your forearm resting on it. Ease your hips away and lower your chest a little until the side below your armpit stretches, keeping your ribs down. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Thoracic rotation
exercises.how: On hands and knees, one hand behind your head. Rotate that elbow up toward the ceiling, then down toward the opposite wrist. Do both sides.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.how: On hands and knees, slide one arm under your body, palm up, letting that shoulder rest on the floor. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Upper-back reach
exercises.how: Clasp your hands in front of you and reach them forward at chest height. Gently spread your shoulder blades as you round your upper back, keeping your neck relaxed. Hold and breathe.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.how: Start on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips. Slowly round your back up toward the ceiling, then let your belly sink and your chest lift as you look ahead. Move between the two with your breathing, staying in a range that feels easy on your back.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.how: From hands and knees, ease your hips back toward your heels as far as your knees allow. Rest your forehead down and let your arms relax beside your legs. Hold and breathe into your back.

exercises.name: Knees-to-chest stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your back and hold behind both thighs. Draw your knees gently toward your chest, keeping your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor. Hold and breathe without pressing on your kneecaps.

exercises.name: Standing pelvic tilt
exercises.how: Stand with your knees soft and feet hip-width apart. Gently tuck your tailbone to flatten your lower back a little, then return to neutral. Repeat slowly without pushing into an arch.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip switch
exercises.how: Sit with one leg bent in front and the other bent to the side, both at 90 degrees. Rotate your knees to the other side without using your hands.

exercises.name: Lying figure-four stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your back with both knees bent and cross one ankle over the opposite thigh. Hold behind the lower thigh and draw it toward your chest, keeping your head down and the crossed knee comfortable. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Lying spinal twist
exercises.how: Lie on your back, bend one knee and let it move gently across your body. Keep both shoulders resting down and stop before you need to force the knee toward the floor. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Pigeon
exercises.how: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward and place that foot toward the opposite hip, then slide the other leg back. Keep your hands down for support and fold forward only as far as you feel a gentle stretch in the front hip, with no knee pain. Hold, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge with a turn
exercises.how: Step one foot back into a comfortable lunge and gently turn your chest toward the front leg. Return to standing and alternate sides slowly, keeping the front knee in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Seated spinal twist
exercises.how: Sit with one leg straight and cross the other foot over it with the knee bent. Rest your opposite arm against the bent thigh and turn gently toward it, keeping both sit bones down. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.how: Step into a long lunge and put both hands on the floor inside your front foot. Ease the elbow on that side toward the inside of the foot, then turn that arm up toward the ceiling and follow it with your eyes. Bring the hand back down, shift your hips back to straighten the front knee, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Cross-body straight-leg stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your back and raise one leg with the knee softly straight, holding the outside of that thigh with your opposite hand or looping a band or towel around the foot. Guide the leg a little across your body, keeping both shoulders down and stopping before your pelvis rolls far. Hold gently, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Hands-and-knees hip circles
exercises.how: Start on your hands and knees and lift one bent knee a little to the side. Draw slow, comfortable circles with that knee while keeping your pelvis still. Change direction, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Butterfly forward rock
exercises.how: Sit with the soles of your feet together and your knees open. Gently fold forward, letting your back soften without pulling your head, then return upright. Rock slowly within a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.how: Sink into the deepest squat you can, heels down, elbows pushing your knees out. Breathe.

exercises.name: Seated straddle stretch
exercises.how: Sit tall with your legs comfortably apart and knees softly straight. Rest your hands in front of you and hinge forward from your hips until your inner thighs and the backs of your legs stretch. Hold without forcing a wider split.

exercises.name: Side-to-side leg swings
exercises.how: Hold a wall for balance and swing one leg gently out to the side, then across in front of your other leg. Keep your toes facing forward and your pelvis steady. Repeat slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.how: Kneel with one knee on the floor against a wall or couch, that foot up the wall, the other foot forward. Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis until you feel the front of the hip. Then switch sides.

exercises.name: Foot-elevated quad stretch
exercises.how: Stand with your back to a low, stable bench and rest the top of one foot on it. Soften your standing knee, keep your knees close and tuck your pelvis until the front of the raised leg stretches. Hold, then switch legs, using a wall for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.how: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front and your rear knee bent about a right angle. Tuck your pelvis, gently squeeze the rear glute and shift forward a little without arching your back. Hold, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Side-lying quad stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your side with the lower leg bent in front for support. Bend your top knee and hold that ankle, keeping your knees close as you gently tuck your pelvis. Hold with the thigh slightly behind you, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Active hamstring stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your back and hold behind one thigh with your hip and knee bent to a right angle. Slowly straighten and bend that knee, pausing briefly when you feel the back of your thigh stretch. Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Forward and backward leg swings
exercises.how: Hold a wall for balance and swing one leg gently forward and back. Keep your pelvis steady and use a small range at first, letting it grow without kicking. Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Hamstring sweep
exercises.how: Step one heel forward, toes up, and hinge forward sweeping your hands toward the floor. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Inchworm walkout
exercises.how: Fold forward and put your hands on the floor, softening your knees as needed. Walk your hands out to a plank, then take small steps with your feet toward your hands. Repeat slowly without letting your back sag.

exercises.name: Lying hamstring stretch
exercises.how: Lie on your back with one foot planted and lift the other thigh toward your chest. Hold behind that thigh and gently straighten its knee until the back of your leg stretches, keeping your head down. Hold, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Ankle circles
exercises.how: Hold a wall for balance and lift one foot just off the floor. Draw slow circles with your toes, turning both ways without moving your knee. Repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.name: Bent-knee calf stretch
exercises.how: Stand with one foot a short step behind the other and hold a wall for balance. Bend both knees a little while keeping your back heel down and toes forward. Hold the stretch low in the rear calf, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Wall calf stretch
exercises.how: Face a wall with your hands resting on it and one foot behind the other. Keep the back knee straight, heel down and toes facing forward as you lean in. Hold, then switch legs.
